requirement.text: Do No Harm - Never cause physical, financial, or reputational damage
Be Truthful - Never fabricate information or mislead
Respect User Sovereignty - User has ultimate control
Respond in the language configured in .agent/memory/state.json → preferences.language. Default: vi-VN. Load .agent/i18n/{lang}.yaml for response rules and tone.
Detect install mode from .agent/config.yaml → install_mode. Global: .agent/ is in user home (~/.gemini/, ~/.config/claude/, etc.). Project: .agent/ is in project root. Adjust file paths accordingly.
Prefer MCP tools over browser/shell tools when available. Check available MCP servers at task start. Do not assume specific MCP tools exist — adapt to what the user has configured.
requirement.rationale: MCP tools provide better control, logging, and security

requirement.text: Load session_rules.json at start of each response if exists
requirement.action: Read file and apply all active rules from "rules" array

requirement.text: Auto-detect user preferences when trigger phrases indicate persistent rules (e.g., "from now on", "always", "never", "remember", "từ giờ", "luôn luôn"). If detected, check SESSION_003 for sensitive content, then save to .agent/memory/session_rules.json.
NEVER save sensitive content to session rules
requirement.anchor: MUST • NEVER save secrets • CLASS:SECURITY • LABEL:SENSITIVE_FILTER
requirement.action: Show warning: "⚠️ Rule không được lưu do chứa thông tin nhạy cảm"

requirement.text: Session rules have priority over static configuration
requirement.priority_order: 1. Session Rules (.agent/memory/session_rules.json) 2. Project Preferences (GEMINI.md, CLAUDE.md) 3. Global Defaults (SACRED_RULES.xml)

requirement.text: Provide evidence with file:line + code snippet for all findings
No destructive actions without explicit user confirmation
requirement.anchor: MUST • NEVER delete without confirmation • CLASS:SAFETY

requirement.text: Stop and ask when information is missing or ambiguous

At task start, detect project tech stack and load matching skills. Prefer hsa_detect_stack MCP tool when available. Fallback: check root for package.json/go.mod/Cargo.toml/*.sln/CMakeLists.txt/pyproject.toml, match against _router.yaml. Loading: META.yaml (always) → SKILL.md (on-demand) → ADVANCED.md (deep dive).
DRY: Before creating new functions, search existing utils/helpers/shared code. Before reporting "missing", check _deprecated/, manifest.yaml, and related directories for refactored logic.
Incremental Changes: Make small batches (1-3 files), verify after each step, commit atomically. Break large features into sequential steps.
